verifiedAgainst.note: CORRECTS ADR-0013. The docs state plainly: 'Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md, not AGENTS.md.' ADR-0013's context claimed Claude Code had added AGENTS.md support, which is wrong. The vendor's own remedy for a repo that has both is a CLAUDE.md whose first line is `@AGENTS.md` — which is this registry's base-plus-delta shape expressed in the target's own import syntax, so the decision survives the error in its premise. Also verified: import syntax is `@path`, maximum four hops; project file may live at ./CLAUDE.md or ./.claude/CLAUDE.md; target under 200 lines.

vendorFields.sizeGuidance: The vendor targets under 200 lines per CLAUDE.md; primaryTokens is set to roughly that at 3.8 chars/token rather than to a hard vendor limit, because no hard limit is documented.
vendorFields.note: Claude Code also supports path-scoped rules in .claude/rules/*.md with a `paths:` front-matter list — the same partitioning idea as Cursor's .mdc globs. Recorded here rather than modelled, because this profile emits the flat memory file; a scoped Claude target would be a separate profile of kind scopedRuleSet.
